dedupe_keys.name: photovoltaik zonen im grunland gem 20 no rog 2014

description: Photovoltaik-Zonen im Grünland gem. §20 NÖ ROG 2014 is a dataset listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sdi.noe.gv.at. Zones defined in the sectoral spatial planning programme on photovoltaic systems in grassland in Lower Austria (NÖ SekROP PV), Lower Austria LGBl No 94/2022, Issued on 22. Coverage: AT. The portal shows the English title as "Photovoltaic zones in grassland according to §20 NÖ ROG 2014" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Zoneneinteilung, Energie, Raumplanung. The listing shows 6 download or service links in JSON, WFS, KML, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
